requirements.title: Database & Transaction Durability
requirements.verification_evidence: Explicit try-rollback-raise blocks on all SQL repositories; 5 rollback failure tests pass.

requirements.title: Cache Degradation & Lifecycle

requirements.title: Circuit Breaker State Transitions

requirements.title: SSE Backpressure & Bounded Streaming
